title: Structural MRI — CAT12 versus FreeSurfer on OASIS-1
description: Portfolio scaffold for comparing CAT12 and FreeSurfer morphometry on a small OASIS-1 subset, including quality control, regional measurements, scatter plots, agreement statistics, and Bland–Altman analysis. The repository currently describes a planned comparison and does not claim completed results.
notes: Portfolio scaffold. The archived repository documents a planned workflow and does not claim completed scientific results.
